name: mikrotik-mcp
description: Monitor and configure MikroTik RouterOS routers from Claude: status, interfaces, firewall, DHCP, Wi-Fi clients, logs, backups and any RouterOS setting.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a MikroTik router over the official RouterOS API (port 8728, or 8729 with TLS, RouterOS 6 and 7) or the REST API (port 443, RouterOS 7.1+). Enter the router's address, port, user name and password, and the connector works out the rest from the port.

Before installing, make sure the API service is on and allows this computer: in the router terminal run `/ip service print`. The `api` line must not be disabled, and its `available-from` must include the address this computer connects from (or be empty). WinBox's port 8291 cannot be used.

Ask Claude to "check the router connection" after installing. If something is wrong, it explains the cause and the fix.

tools.name: mikrotik_set
tools.description: Change a RouterOS item or setting

tools.name: mikrotik_set_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a RouterOS item

host.title: Router address
host.description: IP address or DNS name of the router, for example 192.168.88.1. It must be reachable from this computer, and allowed by the API service's available-from list on the router.

port.title: Port
port.description: 8728 = API (RouterOS 6 and 7), 8729 = API over TLS, 443 = REST over HTTPS (RouterOS 7.1+). Not 8291: that is WinBox, which the connector cannot use.

username.title: User name
username.description: RouterOS user. Its group needs the api policy (plus rest-api for port 443). Use a group without write for read-only access.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password of that RouterOS user. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

insecure.title: Accept self-signed certificate
insecure.description: Needed for ports 8729 and 443 unless the router has a certificate your computer trusts. The connection stays encrypted. No effect on port 8728.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Block every change, so Claude can only look at the router.
